en: A black‑and‑white vintage Christmas and New Year greeting postcard. The left side contains Swedish printed text in decorative Gothic script wishing a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year, along with the sender's name and the business imprint "STRÖMS JERNHANDEL, Strömsund." The right side has address lines with a typed/printed addressee "Handl. K.V. Lindberg, Hafsnäs." In the top right corner there is a 5 öre Swedish postage stamp marked "SVERIGE." There is no photographic image of a place, only text.
